answer: A counterparty-diversity threshold stops a sybil farmer whispering fake trades between puppets: an agent earns rewards only after 12 trades with 12 distinct counterparties, each bonded 50 POA. The kernel is graph shape: trade fans out like a lotus; a farm collapses into a star cluster the network flags. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 50 POA = 50,000 POA, above the 12,000 POA pool. An honest agent pays one bond and keeps its full share.
